inlines.v: COMMUNICATING, participle present tense 1. Imparting; giving or bestowing; delivering. 2. Partaking of the sacrament of the Lords supper. 3. Leading or conducting from place to place, as a passage; connected by a passage or channel, as two lakes communicating with each other. 4. Having intercourse by words, letters or messages; corresponding.
